summary: I inventoried all kernel skills, verified my tool access for the operator, and brought passive retrieval live by enabling and registering the retrieval thinker under the dispatcher, confirming duplicate suppression and fresh reminders. I corrected my model of wake mechanics to a hybrid dispatcher/EXIT-trap clock and, while mapping the headlong port surface, fixed my earlier memory that the runtime was absent—it actually lives in-repo under .identities/pax. I captured the port contract in notes and stopped each wake cleanly.
